title: . Authority for amendments to this title
text:
19.33.010. Authority for amendments to this title.
The city council shall have all powers and authority derived from the state constitution and laws, the city charter, and as specifically described in this section. In addition, they may from time to time amend, supplement, or change by ordinance the text of this title, on the city's initiative or upon a request for a text amendment, following review and recommendation by the city plan commission.
(Ord. 16882 § 2(part), 2008)
(Ord. No. 17236, § 17, 11-10-2009)
